profile.headline: Lead Developer at Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas
profile.summary:
- Certified Appian Lead Developer with experience in  designing , developing and integrating with third party API's. 
- 15 years of experience in the design, development, deployment and maintenance of web and windows based applications using Java and Microsoft technologies including AWS and Windows Azure. 
- Experience and usage of Object Oriented Methodology and Design Patterns in programming
- Experience in Agile Development Methodologies like SAFe framework, Scrum and Extreme programming.

Cloud Technology:  AWS

Specialties: 
LANGUAGES:
Java, Python, Appian, C#.NET, VB.NET, HTML5, Angular JS, XML, JavaScript, jQuery library

DATA:
JPA, Hibernate, Entity framework

OTHERS:
Springboot, REST API, gRPC, Kafka, Micornaut, Maven, Gradle, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, AJAX, Windows Azure, ASMX and WCF web services, REST based WCF services, WPF, MSMQ, CSS, IIS 6.0 and 7.0

TOOLS:
Eclipse, IntelliJ, Visual Studio 2003-2012, MS Visio, Team Foundation Server, JIRA, Jenkins, CruiseControl.Net, MSBuild, NUnit, Windows Installer XML (WiX), CodeSmith generator with .netTiers

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
-Implemented Cloud based Content delivery system. It delivers content to local server located at each store.
-Hands on experience with MVC 3.0/4.0 ASP.NET 4.0./ C#. 
-Work experience of web application hosted in Azure.
-Used ADO.NET Entity Framework for data layer.
-Working Experience of WCF, REST services.
-Also worked on SSIS and Reporting services.
- Worked on reporting cubes using SSAS.
-Prototype user interfaces via Microsoft Expression Blend – SketchFlow.

positions.title: Sr.Test Engineer
positions.description: Lead the team of 5 test Engineer. Worked on Various test applciation for TI's EVM solution. Developled Hardware/ software Test solution for various vendors of SVTronics.
